articles.title: Notion rolls out AI-powered meeting notes for Business plans
articles.description: Notion launched a new AI feature that automatically generates meeting notes and action items inside docs, available first to Business and Enterprise customers.

articles.title: Notion launches global brand campaign 'Connected Workspace'
articles.description: Notion kicked off a new global ad campaign positioning itself as the connected workspace for modern teams, its first major marketing push in two years.

articles.title: Linear raises new growth round to expand enterprise roadmap
articles.description: Linear closed a new funding round aimed at expanding its enterprise feature set and growing its international go-to-market team.

articles.title: Linear ships customer requests triage view
articles.description: Linear released a new triage view that helps product teams turn incoming customer feedback into prioritized backlog items faster.

articles.title: Asana appoints new VP of Product to lead AI initiatives
articles.description: Asana named a new VP of Product tasked with accelerating its AI-assisted work management features, signaling a stronger push into AI this year.

articles.title: ClickUp partners with Zoom for native meeting integration
articles.description: ClickUp announced a native Zoom integration letting users start and log meetings directly from tasks without switching apps.

articles.title: ClickUp mentioned in roundup of productivity apps for students
articles.description: A general listicle briefly mentions ClickUp among ten productivity apps recommended for college students returning to school.
